data.name: Jawziyah
data.gender_notes: Jawziyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name that symbolizes the pursuit of justice and fairness, as depicted in the Quran. The name Jawziyah carries the meaning “Justice and fairness” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jawziyah usually hope their child will grow to embody justice and fairness and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that reminds us of the importance of fairness and justice in our daily lives.
data.etymology: Jawziyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Justice and fairness.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jawziyah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: جوزية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من جوز، يعني الشخصية الحازمة القوية
in_arabic.long_meaning: جوزية هو اسم علم مؤنث، مشتق من كلمة جوز، والتي تعني في اللغة العربية الشخصية الحازمة القوية، وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سورة الجن، حيث يقول الله تعالى: 'وَالْجِزْعُ مِنْ خَشْيَةِ اللَّهِ'، وقد استخدم هذا الاسم في العصور الإسلامية المبكرة، ويحمل دلالات روحية عميقة تتعلق بالشخصية القوية والصلبة.

in_urdu.name: جوزیا
in_urdu.meaning: جوز سے ماخوذ، مضبوط و محکم شخصیت کی نشاندہی کرتا ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: جوزیا ایک علم اسم مؤنث ہے، جو جوز سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مضبوط و محکم شخصیت، یہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے اور اسلامی تقالید میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیاء میں، جہاں یہ نام مضبوط و استوار ہونے کی علامت کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے.

in_hindi.name: जौज़िया
in_hindi.meaning: जौज़ से लिया गया, मजबूत और दृढ़ व्यक्तित्व को दर्शाता है
in_hindi.long_meaning: जौज़िया एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है, जो जौज़ से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है मजबूत और दृढ़ व्यक्तित्व, यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में प्रयोग किया जाता है, जहां यह नाम मजबूत और अटल होने की निशानी के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है.

in_pashto.name: جوزيہ
in_pashto.meaning: د قوي او منظم شخصیت ښودل
in_pashto.long_meaning: جوزيہ د مؤنث اسم دی، چی د جوز څخه اخیستل شوی دی، معنی یې د قوي او منظم شخصیت ښودل دي، دا نوم د پښتو کلتور او ژبې سره تړاو لري او د افغانستان او پښتونستان په سیمو کې د کارونې وړ دی.

in_english.name: Jawziyah
in_english.meaning: Derived from Jawz, signifying strong and resolute personality
in_english.long_meaning: Jawziyah is a feminine given name derived from the Arabic word 'Jawz', meaning strong and resolute personality, it has its roots in Islamic tradition and is mentioned in the Quranic context, symbolizing strength and solidity, and is used across various Muslim cultures to signify a person with a firm and unyielding character.

data.cultural_impact: Jawziyah is the name of a famous Islamic scholarly and jurisconsult, Abu al-Hasan al-Jawziyah, who lived during the end of the Abbasid Caliphate era in Iraq. He is known for his significant contributions to Islamic jurisprudence, philosophy, and literature. His works became essential references for scholars in the fields of Islamic law and theology. Thus, the name Jawziyah holds an important place in Islamic history and is often associated with intellectual excellence and the pursuit of knowledge.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Jawziyah is derived from the Arabic word "al-Jauza" which translates to "the forbidden thing," symbolizing the boundary or threshold that should not be crossed. Muslims are encouraged to uphold Justice and fairness, as stated in the Quran (5:8), "O you who believe, stand out firmly for justice, as witnesses to Allah, even if it is against yourselves or your parents or your kin or your rich or your poor." By embodying the name Jawziyah, one can reflect on the spiritual significance of striving for justice and fairness in their daily lives, upholding the values of Islam and serving as a positive influence on their community and the world.
